---
title: "What are the dimensions of the fully optimized 3 mm glider?"
---

{{< include _model.qmd >}}

```{python}
ENTRY_CEILING = 50.0   # s for this render, granted by the user
SOLVE_BUDGET = 40.0     # s for any one solve
PROBE_POOL = 130.0        # s granted for the probe
PROBE_SPENT = 75.2      # s the probe actually used

res = optimize_full_glider(verbose=False)
sol = res['sol']
airplane = res['airplane']

c_root = float(sol.value(airplane.wings[0].xsecs[0].chord)) * 1000
c_tip = float(sol.value(airplane.wings[0].xsecs[1].chord)) * 1000
sweep = float(sol.value(res['sweep']))
dihedral = float(sol.value(res['dihedral']))
h_span = float(sol.value(res['h_span'])) * 1000
h_chord = float(sol.value(res['h_chord'])) * 1000
v_span = float(sol.value(airplane.wings[2].span())) * 1000
v_chord = float(sol.value(airplane.wings[2].xsecs[0].chord)) * 1000
boom_len = float(sol.value(res['boom_len'])) * 1000
h_inc = float(sol.value(airplane.wings[1].xsecs[0].twist))
cg_x = float(sol.value(airplane.xyz_ref[0])) * 1000

data = [
    ["Span (fixed)", "300.0 mm", "H-tail span", f"{h_span:.1f} mm"],
    ["Root chord", f"{c_root:.1f} mm", "H-tail chord", f"{h_chord:.1f} mm"],
    ["Tip chord", f"{c_tip:.1f} mm", "H-tail inc.", f"{h_inc:.1f}°"],
    ["Wing sweep", f"{sweep:.1f}°", "V-tail span", f"{v_span:.1f} mm"],
    ["Dihedral", f"{dihedral:.1f}°", "V-tail chord", f"{v_chord:.1f} mm"],
    ["Tail boom", f"{boom_len:.1f} mm", "CG (from root LE)", f"{cg_x:.1f} mm"]
]

md = "| Wing / Body | Dimension | Tail | Dimension |\n|---|---|---|---|\n"
for row in data:
    md += f"| {row[0]} | {row[1]} | {row[2]} | {row[3]} |\n"
md += ": Table detailing the geometric dimensions and center of gravity for the fully optimized 3 mm foam glider. {#tbl-plans}\n"
```

**Answer.** The fully optimized plans feature a [`{python} f"{sweep:.1f}"`]{.key}° forward sweep, strong taper down to an [`{python} f"{c_tip:.1f}"`]{.key} mm tip, and a short [`{python} f"{boom_len:.1f}"`]{.key} mm tail boom. Dimensions are extracted into (@tbl-plans).

```{python}
#| echo: false
#| output: asis
print(md)
```
